  - "Start with the outside: what does the whole thing look like?"

writeup: |
  The outer layer is Base64: mixed case, digits, an `=` at the end. Decoding it gives pairs like `2D 20 2E 2E`, which is hex.

  The hex decodes to characters that are only `-`, `.`, `/` and spaces: Morse. That decodes to `THE LAST DOLL IS HOLLOW`.

  After each layer, stop and look at the output as if it were a new puzzle. The tells are the same at every depth.

A set of nesting dolls, each one painted with text. The outermost doll has the longest line. You've copied it down.
